CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mschool.payroll_actor(p_actor text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare a jsonb;begin a:=public.school_resolve_session(p_actor);if a is null or a->>'role_type'<>'同工' or not exists(select 1 from mschool.payroll_reviewer_accounts r join mschool.staff_access link on link.user_id=r.user_id and link.auth_user_id=r.auth_user_id where r.user_id=a->>'id'and link.is_active and link.role_type='同工')then raise exception 'school_access_denied'using errcode='42501';end if;return a;end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mschool.payroll_snapshot(p_month date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with lines as(select s.id,s.date,s.worker_id,u.name,u.role_type,s.shift,s.job_desc,round(extract(epoch from upper(mschool.shift_range(s.date,s.shift))-lower(mschool.shift_range(s.date,s.shift)))/3600,4) hours,r.hourly_wage,round(extract(epoch from upper(mschool.shift_range(s.date,s.shift))-lower(mschool.shift_range(s.date,s.shift)))*r.hourly_wage/3600,2) amount from mschool.schedules s join mschool.users u on u.id=s.worker_id left join lateral(select hourly_wage from mschool.payroll_rates where worker_id=s.worker_id and effective_from<=s.date order by effective_from desc limit 1)r on true where s.date>=p_month and s.date<(p_month+interval '1 month') and u.role_type in ('老師','工讀生')),
workers as(select worker_id,max(name) name,max(role_type) role_type,sum(hours) hours,round(sum(amount),2) amount,count(*)filter(where hourly_wage is null or hours is null or hours<=0) missing_rates,jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l) order by date,id) shifts from lines l group by worker_id)
select jsonb_build_object('basis','planned_schedule_hours','month',to_char(p_month,'YYYY-MM'),'workers',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w)order by worker_id)from workers w),'[]'::jsonb),'total_hours',coalesce((select sum(hours)from workers),0),'total_amount',coalesce((select sum(amount)from workers),0),'missing_rates',coalesce((select sum(missing_rates)from workers),0),'source_hash',md5(coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l)order by id)::text from lines l),'[]')));$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.school_payroll_month_end()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare due date:=mschool.payroll_due_month(now()at time zone 'Asia/Taipei');m date;b mschool.payroll_months;created int:=0;begin if due is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'skipped','not_month_end_21');end if;perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(57203,2);for m in select x::date from generate_series(date '2026-11-01',due,interval '1 month')x loop perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('payroll:'||m,57031));insert into mschool.payroll_months(month,snapshot)values(m,mschool.payroll_snapshot(m))on conflict(month)do nothing returning * into b;if b.id is not null then insert into mschool.payroll_audit(month_id,actor_id,action,to_stage,payload)values(b.id,'system','month_end_settle','yuting',b.snapshot);perform mschool.payroll_queue(b);created:=created+1;end if;end loop;return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'created',created);end$function$
